# The Operative Group

> Hybrid real estate brokerage and investment firm based in Eugene and Springfield, Oregon,
> operating under REAL Broker, with 21 advisors working across the state.
> Ranked #6 in Oregon for sides and #7 for volume in 2024 (Wall Street Journal / RealTrends).
> 140+ transactions and $55M+ in volume over the last twelve months. Phone 458.209.0163.
> Email dan@theoperativegroup.com.

## Coverage, stated honestly
Lane County (Eugene, Springfield, and 22 more communities) is the home market, worked daily.
Their own active listings also show the team transacting in Douglas County (Roseburg), Marion
County (Salem) and on the coast. Everywhere else in Oregon is worked through the team and
REAL Broker's referral network of nearly 10,000 agents. The site says which is which on every
region page, not implying statewide coverage it can’t evidence.

## What they do
Four ways to sell a house: list on the RMLS, sell off market to a curated list of 700+ accredited
and cash investors, sell directly into the partners' own portfolio, or take an institutional offer.
Buyer representation by client type. Investment brokerage with an APOD, CMA and marketing plan on
every deal. Certified probate, trust and conservatorship representation. Relocation programs in and
out of Oregon. Downsizing programs. Agent recruiting.

## Key Oregon facts published on this site (with sources)
- Oregon middle housing (HB 2001): cities over 25,000 must allow duplexes, triplexes, quadplexes,
 townhouses and cottage clusters where detached single-family homes are allowed; cities of
 10,000-25,000 must allow a duplex; inside the Portland Metro UGB the threshold is 1,000.
- Portland City Code 30.01.085: a rent increase of 10% or more over a rolling twelve months that
 causes a tenant to move triggers relocation assistance of $2,900 (studio/SRO), $3,300 (1BR),
 $4,200 (2BR) or $4,500 (3BR+). The statewide 2026 cap of 9.5% sits just under that trigger.
- ORS 115.005: a claim against an Oregon estate is barred unless presented before the later of
 four months after first publication of notice, or 30 days after a required direct notice.
- Oregon 2026 maximum rent increase: 9.5% for most long-term residential rentals (ORS 90.323);
 6% for manufactured home facilities and marinas with more than 30 spaces; properties under
 15 years old are exempt; 90-day written notice; once per 12 months; never in the first year.
- Eugene ADUs: allowed in all residential zones; detached ADU capped at 800 sq ft or 10% of lot
 area, whichever is smaller; owner occupancy not required.
- Oregon small estate affidavit: available when the estate is $275,000 or less, with no more than
 $200,000 real property and $75,000 personal property; can’t be filed until 30 days after death;
 $124 filing fee. Formal probate petition typically $298 for estates from $50,000 to $1 million.
- ORS 114.325: unless the will provides otherwise, a personal representative may sell or convey
 real property without a court hearing, with stated exceptions.
- Lane County probate is filed at Lane County Circuit Court, 125 East 8th Avenue, Eugene, OR 97401;
 Probate Department, 2nd floor.
- Lane County median sale price about $464,000 for the three months ending June 2026, down 3.5%
 year over year, median 18 days on market (Redfin).
